description.text:
The Staff FW Engineer, OpenBMC will be based in Taiwan Taipei Wugu Site. The Staff FW Engineer, OpenBMC performs the responsibility for system design in OpenBMC Solution Projects request.
What a typical day looks like:
• Design OpenBMC Firmware by applying knowledge of BMC architecture
• Customize OpenBMC stack to meet customer's requirement
• System level debug and root cause analysis for BMC firmware design
• Cross-function teamwork for issues analysis and debug
• Overall project responsibility in all aspects on SW design related- from project kick off to end of M.P.
The experience we are looking to add to our team:
• Bachelor or above degree in Electrical Engineering or Computer Science
• 8+ years' experience for debugging, development, and testing work in the Linux environment
• Be highly passionate and interested in BMC development and capability of teamwork in multi-task environment
• Solid understanding of software implementation/design experience is required.
• Experience developing device drivers for peripherals and connectivity buses (e.g., I2C, SPI, PMBus, USB).
• Capability of independent research and working with new technologies is required.
• Excellent written and verbal communications skills (in Mandarin and English) is required.
• With strong sense of responsibility (be able to go on business trips, dispatch overseas is preferred)
• Domain expertise in OpenBMC or AST2600 firmware development experience is plus
• OOB or In-band System Management experience with DMTF standards IPMI and Redfish is plus.
The information we collect:
We may collect personal information that you choose to submit to us through the Website or otherwise provide to us. This may include your contact details; information provided in online questionnaires, feedback forms, or applications for employment; and information you provide such as CV/Resume. We will use your information for legitimate business purposes such as responding to comments or queries or answering questions; progressing applications for employment; allowing you to choose to share web content with others or; where you represent one of our customers or suppliers, administering the business relationship with that customer or supplier.
